metric.name: frame_ui_time_p95_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT s.dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.dur) AS rank,
      count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM android_frames_choreographer_do_frame AS d
    JOIN slice AS s USING (id)
    WHERE d.ui_thread_utid IN (SELECT ui_thread_utid FROM frames)
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The app UI thread's p95 frame time increased from 26.299542 ms in the baseline to 103.761958 ms in the current trace, a 77.462416 ms regression.

claims.text: The current UI thread contains 536157 TextLayout:initLayout slices totaling 14372.316042 ms, while the baseline's corresponding top-slice query has no TextLayout:initLayout entry; the current trace also contains 1825 animation slices totaling 5036.788245 ms.

The current trace has 92 full and 92 young garbage collections, compared with 2 full and 1 young collection in the baseline, consistent with substantially greater allocation pressure during the scenario.

Commit e15d633e79d2608f074e9c50a18f3064e15830d7 adds repeated text measurement in PostTitle and an infinite row-breath animation in PostCards.kt; blame assigns those added lines to this commit. These changes correlate with the new TextLayout and animation activity, making this the likely culprit in the supplied range.

caveats: the current trace's build was debuggable (run metadata: debuggable), so ART ran it with fewer optimisations and its timings overstate a release build's
This conclusion is based on one baseline capture and one current capture, so capture-to-capture variability cannot be quantified.
The current run metadata identifies a debuggable build on the sdk_gphone64_arm64 Android emulator; emulator and debug-build scheduling can amplify timing differences.
